scenes.audio: Is the 100 points you're desperately chasing right now really what you want? Life has four necessary stages. I walked through them this way myself. The first stage: pure happiness.
scenes.label: Opening Hook

scenes.audio: When I was young, I had nothing, but owning one point was one point of joy. Hiding under the piano playing house...
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios

scenes.audio: ...getting dirty all over, yet laughing happier than anyone. The happiness of that time didn't need conditions.
scenes.label: Real Experience

scenes.audio: The second stage: desperate chasing. You start to compare, to calculate. Others have cars and you don't. Others fly business class and you fly economy. You work hard to reach that 100 points.
scenes.label: Problem Solving

scenes.audio: It's like a treadmill. You run faster and faster, your heart rate gets higher and higher, but you look down and you're still in the same place. Because that belt is a speed set by others, not your own rhythm.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios

scenes.audio: Third, the peak of emptiness. The car is bought, the house is lived in, the bag is owned. But what you have isn't the happiness you imagined. Because that 100 points was never your standard, it was someone else's.
scenes.label: Problem Solving

scenes.audio: I left my hometown and started from scratch without any customers, worked my way up to become one of the top 100 Porsche sales consultants in the world.
scenes.label: Real Experience

scenes.audio: One day, a customer chatted with me and suddenly asked, 'Taixin, you're already number one, do you feel happy?' I smiled at the time and said I was quite happy, but after getting back into the car, I thought for a long time because I couldn't answer.
scenes.label: Real Experience

scenes.audio: That moment felt like climbing a very high mountain. Reaching the peak and looking down, you realize the scenery is beautiful, but your heart knows this mountain was never the one you wanted to climb.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios

scenes.audio: You climbed it because others were climbing it, so you followed. Or was it because you yourself wanted to climb?
scenes.label: Real Experience

scenes.audio: Then came the fourth stage: awakening. You ask yourself, what am I living for?
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios

scenes.audio: And this question will torment you for a long time, but it's this pain that will force you to find your own answer. When you find it, you'll return to the first stage, where one point of possession is one point of joy.
scenes.label: Problem Solving

scenes.audio: No longer out of ignorance, but because you truly understand. What's the difference? Childhood happiness is instinct; happiness after awakening is a choice.
scenes.label: Real Experience

scenes.audio: Which stage are you at? Leave a comment and let me know. I am Taixin, leading you to understand human nature and close high-value deals.
scenes.label: Call to Action
